text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow's Classic year is 
finally about to begin—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
—Progress looks good. She is recovering 
smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Please continue to be careful not to put 
excessive strain on your legs as you 
train.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yes! Thank you very much.

The damage to Bubble Gum Fellow's legs was 
steadily fading. At this rate, entering 
the Classic races should be well within 
reach.

Afterward, I returned with Bubble Gum 
Fellow to the deserted academy in the 
quiet of the New Year—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad there are clear signs of 
recovery. It looks like she'll make it in 
time for the Satsuki Sho...!
choice_data_list:
Yeah. But we can't let our guard down just 
yet...!

Yeah. But we can't let our guard down just 
yet...!

text_block_list.text:
Having a period of time to dedicate to 
recovery also means there is still a 
possibility that some sort of trouble 
might occur.
choice_data_list: Let's keep sticking to the recovery plan!

text_block_list.text:
Based on the plan I drew up under a 
doctor's supervision late last year, we'll 
balance damage recovery and training at 
the same time.

As her Trainer, I must firmly take charge 
of the areas Bubble Gum Fellow herself 
might not notice...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...You're right! Sorry, I'll make sure to 
stay focused.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I need to accurately pick up on the 
"warning signs" of my limit too—

—The "premonitions" that Bubble Gum Fellow 
speaks of. That is crucial information 
needed to further refine her limiter and 
automate it.

"In a race, split-second decisions dictate 
victory or defeat. If you're constantly 
second-guessing when you'll reach your 
limit while running, you might miss your 
chance to win."

"That's why what becomes necessary is 
grasping the 'warning signs' of hitting 
the limit."

"As long as I can grasp the 'omens,' to 
put it simply, all I have to do is 
activate the limiter in response. As a 
result, it conserves cognitive resources 
during the race."

By repeating the entire sequence—from 
perceiving this "omen" to activating the 
limiter— and drilling it into muscle 
memory, it will become fully automated—

"By doing so, the future goal was to make 
Bubble Gum Fellow's running style safe and 
efficient...!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Automating your limiter. Make sure you 
master it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Alright, after this we're just doing a 
light run, right? Let's get ready right 
away—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? That is—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Hey! Air Groove. Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Bubble, is it? Happy New Year.

The Umamusume whom Bubble Gum Fellow spoke 
to, Air Groove, is currently one of the 
most promising contenders on the Tiara 
route.

Bubble Gum Fellow had previously mentioned 
to me that the two of them were 
classmates.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: About to train?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, keeping it light. What about you, 
Air Groove? Student council work?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. There was something I wanted to make 
progress on over the New Year's holiday.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, that ended a moment ago. I'm 
thinking of doing some voluntary training 
after this."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yes. Then—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. For the training after this, 
would you mind if I ran together with Air 
Groove?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
How about it, Air Groove? It'll improve 
the quality of training for both of us. I 
don't think it's a bad offer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? From what you told me 
before, you're supposed to be focusing on 
recovering your right leg right now—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That's why it's "light." Even so, I still 
want to raise the quality as much as 
possible.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I really thought we could pull it off if 
it was with Air Groove, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...If that is the case, very well. With 
you, I certainly can expect results.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's settled. ...I guess you 
could call this friendship training?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh, what a bizarre thing to say—

To be honest, I was surprised. I had heard 
that the Umamusume named Air Groove was 
extremely stoic, strong-willed, and 
strict, but—

She readily accepted Bubble Gum Fellow's 
sudden proposal. Perhaps their bond of 
trust is just that strong.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer. What were we planning to do 
first again?
choice_data_list:
Since we have the chance, let's do a light 
match race.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Okay. Let's get changed and meet up at the 
gym then!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Hup...! Hup...! Last one...! ...Phew——

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I think I've warmed up pretty 
well...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well done. I can tell you have trained 
thoroughly without neglecting anything.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'm in prime training mode right now, you 
know. Care to join me next time?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Very well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Bubble's Trainer. It's fine if we go a bit 
harder on the upper body, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Then I shall show you how the 
"Empress" does things. Don't you dare cry 
surrender.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Fufu, nice. I'm getting fired up...!

And so, by cooperating with Air Groove, 
Bubble Gum Fellow was able to have a 
fulfilling training session—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today, Air Groove! We got to do 
so much, it was really fulfilling thanks 
to you.
choice_data_list: Thank you so much, from me too!

A truly heartfelt thank you from me as 
well!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Okay. Then let's head straight to the 
Trainer's room as is!

text_block_list.name: Video Audio
text_block_list.text:
“Here comes the final stretch!! They're 
all packed together in a tight bunch!! 
Wait, from the far outside?! Here comes a 
huge charge!”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Her stamina is incredible...! Even after 
being forced so far wide, she still has 
that much left in her legs."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. She likely ruled out taking the 
inside lane early on and chose to conserve 
her stamina. Her gamble of trusting her 
late-race kick paid off.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Bold, aren't you? I don't dislike that 
sort of thing. Would Air Groove adjust the 
plan, though?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fifty-fifty. Take the downhill section, 
for example. The moment the inside got 
blocked there, she could have shifted 
position... but that too would have been a 
gamble.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I see. Stacking bet upon bet really might 
be a poor move—

Bubble Gum Fellow and Air Groove intently 
continue to analyze the same video 
footage.

Whether due to a matching conversational 
tempo or way of thinking, the two 
continued to analyze various footages 
without missing a beat—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today, Air Groove! We got to do 
so much, it was really fulfilling thanks 
to you.
choice_data_list: Thank you so much, from me too!

A truly heartfelt thank you from me as 
well!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice! That definitely looks like good 
practice for the limiter!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Limiter? Wait, more importantly, are 
you okay to run?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
As long as you're not going all out like 
in a race, it'll be fine. I'll explain 
about the limiter later, too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
――...I see. To avoid unintentionally 
pushing past your limits, then.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In my case, I'm the type who fires up 
especially during a close contest. Right 
now, I'm looking for various "signs" of my 
limit—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'd like Air Groove to try overtaking me 
while I run ahead of her.
choice_data_list:
For that one too, if you can, make it a 
close contest.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Provoking my fighting spirit... I see. 
Very well. It seems this will serve as 
training for my pace control as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Bubble, if you're gonna do this, you'd 
better brace yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
My late charge is truly sensational, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: That's why it's great, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ââHah!!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Haha! That's intense...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (It's thrilling...!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that was close...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(Still, I feel like I'm starting to 
understand a bit—)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hoh, held it back, did you...!

And so, with Air Groove's help, we were 
able to conduct limiter training—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today, Air Groove! We got to do 
so much, it was really fulfilling thanks 
to you.
choice_data_list: Thank you so much, from me too!

A truly heartfelt thank you from me as 
well!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No thanks are necessary. I gained 
something from it as well. Training on my 
own wouldn't have turned out like this.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Last year made me painfully aware of 
my many shortcomings."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, I will not let that happen this 
year. For that, I must greedily seize 
every opportunity to gain experience and 
grow...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...That's just like you, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
“...The sun has gone down quite a bit. I 
suppose it's time for me to get going.”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Bubble. I will make this the year of my 
breakthrough.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Same here. Our paths might be different, 
but let's make it flashy!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh, indeed—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Air Groove was really fired up, huh—
choice_data_list: You two get along pretty well.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
How do I put it? Our personalities are 
different, but I feel like I really 
understand the way she thinks.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Is 'Sympathy' the closest thing?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Just like me, Air Groove has a parent who 
manages a racing club.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Though the difference is that theirs 
is a mother, while mine is a father.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe it's the influence of both our 
parents. Whenever we meet face to face, we 
end up talking about the racing world's 
present and future—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
At times like that, you hear little things 
in what they say, and it's like, 'Oh, I 
totally get that!'

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That always inspires me... It makes me 
think, 'Alright, I'll do my best too!'

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You know... It's a little different from 
the kind of inspiration I get from the 
Four Heavenly Kings.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"It was the same today. When I heard Air 
Groove's words, I thought, 'I can't afford 
to lose'...!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Fufu— I think so too.

Bubble Gum Fellow and Air Groove. As peers 
of the same generation, the two are set to 
take on this year's Classic races 
together...

I found myself letting my thoughts wander 
toward the future waiting beyond this 
reality—to the moment when sparks would 
fly between the two of them—
